additions.name: Latechco Aguada Park, existing operations

status.summary: Latechco reported serving its customers from all three of its Montevideo data centers on October 8, 2026. The operator and UNIT identify Aguada Park as one of those properties.

locator.identity_review: Latechco identifies the Aguada Park facility at Paraguay 2141. The host gives the same address, the municipal register returns one matching point and UNIT names the data center.

additions.distinctness_review: The commercial Aguada Park facility is physically separate from the two World Trade Center facilities. additions.name: FCDC Kerava data centre — permitted building

status.summary: Kerava granted a building permit for one single-storey data-centre building with 13,236 m² of gross floor area, including ancillary space. The city published its decision on November 16.
status.permit_identity_review: Page 1 identifies the data-centre building, its gross floor area, Nybackantie 6 and cadastral reference 245-401-1-207. Page 7 gives the decision and public notice dates.

locator.method: Transform the National Land Survey’s reference point for cadastral component 226667909 from EPSG:3067 to WGS 84 (longitude, latitude).
locator.precision: Representative point on the permitted property at Nybackantie 6.
locator.identity_review: The municipal permit names parcel 245-401-1-207. Its published point falls inside only component 226667909 of the parcel’s three detached components. The official cadastral reference point is 37 m from the permit point and lies on the same component.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral service gives no measured horizontal error for its reference point.

additions.distinctness_review: No matching civic address, parcel, municipality or Jokivarsi plan alias occurs in canonical projects, sites, historical identity or inherited source records. The nearest existing site is Hetzner Helsinki Data Center Park (Huurrekuja 10, Tuusula) (6.2 km).
additions.successor_review: Kerava’s November 17 update confirms the permit covered about one-fifth of the construction obligation in the preliminary land-sale agreement. The city still owned the land. The permit covers the named data-centre building and associated works.

additions.name: Etelän Datacenter Rastikangas

status.summary: Janakkala’s permit subcommittee granted a building permit for the Rastikangas data centre and its associated works on November 11.
status.permit_reference: Janakkala permit subcommittee, November 11, 2026, §50, building permit 165-2026-118
status.permit_identity_review: The subcommittee adopted the permit proposal. Its minutes identify a two-storey data centre on the named cadastral parcel at Rastivainiontie 4.

locator.method: Transform the National Land Survey’s official cadastral parcel reference point from EPSG:3067 to WGS 84 (longitude, latitude).
locator.precision: Representative point on the permitted property at Rastivainiontie 4, Turenki.
locator.identity_review: Janakkala’s adopted minutes and the permit proposal identify parcel 165-424-4-4. The official search returns one polygon and reference point for that exact property. Its area agrees with the developer’s approximately 22 hectares.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral service gives no measured horizontal error for the parcel reference point.

additions.distinctness_review: No matching developer project, municipal name, site address or parcel identifier occurs in canonical projects, sites, historical identity records or inherited sources. The nearest existing site is Verne Mäntsälä Data Center Campus (50.4 km).
additions.successor_review: The municipality confirmed the November 11 vote the following day. The developer’s presentation describes future operation, and the building decision covers the data centre and associated works.

additions.name: DayOne Kodaira Data Center — Phase One

status.summary: On October 22, 2026, the project representative confirmed to local residents that construction of the new data-centre building in Tenjincho had formally begun.

locator.method: Centroid of Kodaira City tax parcel 211:59-1 in JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular coordinate system IX, transformed to WGS84 and rounded to five decimal places.
locator.precision: Representative point on the development parcel. The Phase One building footprint is not separately mapped.
locator.identity_review: The original municipal land-use record identifies lot 59-1 in Tenjincho 1-chome. Only one matching 211:59-1 feature occurs in the city parcel layer. The national government geocoder independently places its centroid in this same town block.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The city describes the tax map as an indicative representation of parcels and gives no positional accuracy for a centre point.

additions.distinctness_review: One private data-centre development is recorded on Tenjincho 1-chome parcel 59-1. Phase One shares the physical site with the planned whole-campus build-out. The nearest snapshot 189 site is Mitsui Fudosan Hino Hinodai Data Center Site (former Hino Motors west plant), 12.2 km away.
additions.successor_review: The October construction report confirms actual new-building work after the September groundbreaking. The November 13 council-member request to the mayor concerns consultation on the project and does not report a later physical stage. The DayOne Fuchu campus is explicitly separate.
